components.note: Explicit coding x=2a-1, z=2b-1 and zero-one coding; conditional effects Delta_A(0), Delta_A(1), equal-weight average Delta_A, difference of differences D_AB derived via H_2 (written proof in annex). The retained opposite-sign example (4,0,0,2) giving -4, 2, -1, 6 is explicitly preserved; no failure condition holds.

Repeated runs: cell-mean variance sigma^2/n_j, pure-error SS with expectation (N-m)sigma^2 and the SSE decomposition; residual df N-r and unbiased s^2. Blocked assignment: block contrasts eliminate additive block effects with variance sigma^2 sum c_t^2/B and (L-1)(B-1) residual df; design-based blocked variance depends only on within-block spread. Repeated measurements on one unit are distinguished from independently assigned units (variance sigma_U^2+sigma_e^2/q; HB 195-198; OB 330-333). All proofs written.

Principal half fraction x3=x1x2 tabulated; I=123 with complete alias classes; the columns x3 and x1x2 coincide and (beta_3+t, beta_12-t) leaves every fitted response unchanged, so only their sum is recovered; general alias theorem proved; source data show fraction contrasts equal alias sums. No separate estimation of aliased effects.

Warranted assignment contrast tau with unbiased weighting estimator and the P19 weights (HB 711-712); mechanism non-identification proved by two finite structural models with identical factorial surface; additional premises for a mechanism claim stated (process measurements with a measurement model, separating interventions or controls, linking assumptions; HB 736-741). No claim that a significant coefficient proves the mechanism.
